facility.name: Mama Grace Playhouse

provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - No Play or Eating Surfaces Used: An infants diaper was changed on the sofa.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - No Play or Eating Surfaces Used (26 TAC §747.3303(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Two out of three child records evaluated had out of date immunizations on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §747.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training -skill based and hands on: The primary and assistant caregivers do not have current training in pediatric CPR. The training expired on 05/11/2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training -skill based and hands on (26 TAC §747.1313(b))

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Never Allow Toddlers to Sleep or Walk With Bottles and Training Cups: A toddler was observed to be asleep with a bottle in the pack and play.    This was corrected when it was addressed and the bottle was removed from the pack and play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Never Allow Toddlers to Sleep or Walk With Bottles and Training Cups (26 TAC §747.2405(4)(C))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns: The food program child meal patterns were not followed during lunch time as the meal was lacking food components such as a vegetable, fruit, and milk. A child was served a bean and cheese taco for lunch.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns (26 TAC §747.3101(b))

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers: The primary and assistant caregiver do not have current training in pediatric first-aid. The training expired on 05/11/2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1313(a))

occurrences.finding: Requirements during probation: The operation did not meet the condition regarding creating a plan 30 days prior to the probation ending addressing how the operation plan to maintain compliance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements during probation (26 TAC §745.8641)

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training: Complete training records for one caregiver were unavailable for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training (26 TAC §747.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Parent Provided Meals/Snacks - Provide Safe Storage: A meal that was provided by a parent for their child was halved and shared with another child in care. The meal was not intended for two children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parent Provided Meals/Snacks - Provide Safe Storage (26 TAC §747.3109(c))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Second Serving: There was not enough food served to provide for a second serving of vegetable, fruit, grain, and milk groups.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Second Serving (26 TAC §747.3101(e))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation - Safe and Sanitary: A caregiver fed a child lunch with their hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation - Safe and Sanitary (26 TAC §747.3117)

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns: The meal served did not follow the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) Child and Adult Care Food Program (CACFP) meal patterns as it was lacking food components such as a fruit and vegetable.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns (26 TAC §747.3101(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The children's product certification had not been certified in over 12 months. It was last certified in September 2024.    This was corrected at inspection when the Children's Product Certification form was re-certified.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))

occurrences.finding: Requirements during probation: The operation did not have documentation to indicate which subchapter was reviewed for October and what date it was reviewed. They also did not have it noted down when they reviewed the HHS website.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements during probation (26 TAC §745.8641)

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing Before Eating: A child's hands were not washed before sitting down for snack.     This was corrected at inspection when it was addressed with the caregiver and hands were washed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing Before Eating (26 TAC §747.3213(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement: Re-cite: One out of four child records evaluated were lacking a health statement signed by a doctor. The child has been enrolled for over 12 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement (26 TAC §747.611(a))

occurrences.finding: Requirements during probation: Re-cite: The operation has not met the conditions set by Child Care Enforcement. They failed to conduct a quarterly review of deficiencies. They also have not completed a child records evaluation form since June 2025. The operation has also not documented areas of concerns identified during daily walkthroughs and what was done to correct the concern.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements during probation (26 TAC §745.8641)

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement: Two out of four child records evaluated were lacking a health statement signed by a doctor. Both children have been enrolled for over 12 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement (26 TAC §747.611(a))

occurrences.finding: Requirements during probation: The operation has not met the condition set by Child Care Enforcement. They failed to maintain dated documentation of the subchapters being reviewed. The operation also did not review the HHSC website as required per probation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements during probation (26 TAC §745.8641)

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation - Use Sanitary Holders: Two children were served a snack without a sanitary holder.    This was corrected at inspection when it was addressed with the caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation - Use Sanitary Holders (26 TAC §747.3117(5))

occurrences.finding: Requirements during probation: The provider did not comply with the conditions set in the corrective action plan. The provider did not create an individual training plan within the required 15 days nor did the provider include screen time in the operational policies within the 15 days.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements during probation (26 TAC §745.8641)

occurrences.finding: Menus Available to Licensing: A menu for the current week was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Menus Available to Licensing (26 TAC §747.3113(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: 5 children in care did not participate in outdoor activities in the afternoon for the minimum daily required time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities (26 TAC §747.2104(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Redirecting Behavior: Multiple negative statements were witnessed being utilized by a caregiver when redirecting children's behavior.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Redirecting Behavior (26 TAC §747.2703(4)(C))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily: Screen time was observed to exceed one hour.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily (26 TAC §747.2105(c)(3))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Screen time was being utilized while a child under 2 years of age was present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §747.2105(a))

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Bottles & Training Cups Labeled for Each Toddler: Four toddler cups were observed to be lacking a label identifying which child it belongs to. A cup was given to the wrong child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Bottles & Training Cups Labeled for Each Toddler (26 TAC §747.2405(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - No Play or Eating Surfaces Used: A diaper was changed on the sofa and there was not a diaper changing mat utilized.    This was corrected at inspection when it was addressed and a non-absorbant mat that can be utilized for diaper changing was made available by the owner.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - No Play or Eating Surfaces Used (26 TAC §747.3303(b))

occurrences.finding: Handwashing Procedures: A caregiver did not use soap and water to wash hands after changing a diaper.    This was corrected at inspection when it was addressed with the caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Handwashing Procedures (26 TAC §747.3215)

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: Re-cited: This citation is being recited because operation failed to update and create complete operational policies. The operational polices were lacking several required items including: a statement regarding medication administration, promotion of indoor/outdoor physical activity, parent rights, emergency preparedness, and information on how to access the abuse/neglect hotline and HHSC website.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §747.207(1))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The operational polices were lacking several required items including: a statement regarding medication administration, promotion of indoor/outdoor physical activity, parent rights, emergency preparedness, and information on how to access the abuse/neglect hotline and HHSC website.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §747.207(1))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Screen time activities were utilized when a child under 2 years old was present.    This was corrected at inspection when it was addressed and the screen time activity ended.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §747.2105(a))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-Keeping Children Safe Poster: The Keeping Children Safe poster was not posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements-Keeping Children Safe Poster (26 TAC §747.401(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File: 2 out of 4 children's records reviewed were lacking a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File (26 TAC §747.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The operational polices were lacking several required items including: a statement regarding medication administration, safe sleep policy for infants, promotion of indoor/outdoor physical activity, parent rights, and emergency preparedness.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §747.207(1))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation: Documentation for safety drills was not available.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-Inspection Report: The most recent licensing inspection form was not posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements-Inspection Report (26 TAC §747.401(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Proof of Liability Insurance: There were no documents to verify that the parents have been notified in writing that the operation does not carry liability insurance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Proof of Liability Insurance (26 TAC §747.801(14))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Re-Cited: 1 out of 4 children's records reviewed were missing immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers: The primary caregiver and substitute caregiver are both lacking up to date pediatric first aid and CPR. Both caregivers trainings expired in 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1313(a))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation - Use Sanitary Holders: 2 children were served their afternoon snack on a bare table.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation - Use Sanitary Holders (26 TAC §747.3117(5))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 1 out of 4 children's records reviewed were missing immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Sanitation of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The dining room and kitchen area had large amounts of mail, paperwork, and various items that children could access. There were multiple toys along the fenceline outside with spiderwebs. There was also a container of lighter fluid and a large jug of disinfectant solution accessible to children in the backyard play area. There were also a couple of cracked/broken play items outside.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sanitation of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §747.3203)

occurrences.finding: Storage of Medication - Inaccessible to Children: There was a ziploc bag with multiple prescription medications located in the dining area and it was accessible to children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Storage of Medication - Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §747.3607(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission: 1 out of 4 children's records reviewed was missing an admission date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §747.605(3))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The operational policies were not complete.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §747.207(1))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training: Provider lacked 30 hours of annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Caregivers Licensed -24 hours Annual Training: Caregiver lacked 24 annual training hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Caregivers Licensed -24 hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Two of seven children's records reviewed lacked address for emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §747.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The children's product form was not re-certified.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))

occurrences.finding: Crib Activities: One 12 month old baby was left awake in an empty crib for more than 45 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Crib Activities (26 TAC §747.2325)

occurrences.finding: Provide Parents With Copy of Policies: One  out of four children's files lacked a signed copy of acknowledgment of the operational policy.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Provide Parents With Copy of Policies (26 TAC §747.503)

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Scrren time was being used with a child 8 months old and a 13 month old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §747.2105(a))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily: Screen time was observed to be utilized for more than one hour in addition, one 4 year old child was allowed to have screen time on a cell phone for more than one hour.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily (26 TAC §747.2105(c)(3))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: One eight month old child not on table food did not have any written feeding instructions.  A copy of an example of a feeding form was provided.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §747.2321(a))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Licensed Homes - signed dated statement that caregiver attended child maltreatment training (26 TAC §747.901(9))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Using Inappropriate Long Period of Silence or Inactivity Including Requiring Child to Remain in a Restrictive Device: Four toddlers were observed sitting in high chairs for more than 40 minutes to ensure they do not run around the infant child on the floor.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Using Inappropriate Long Period of Silence or Inactivity Including Requiring Child to Remain in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §747.2705(10))
